mandatory: Exactly five lanes, top to bottom: You, agy, Skill files, Google Cloud, Evidence file
Exactly six boxes, one per column, in the lanes stated; the boxes form a staircase down from lane 1 to lane 5, then the last box sits back in lane 1 at the far right
Exactly five arrows, each from one box to the next box in reading order; the last arrow rises from the lane 5 box to the lane 1 box at the far right
'm1_stepN.txt' and 'antigravity-sa' are monospace and each stays on one line, with the capital N kept
Each box is wide enough that its label fits on at most two lines
The title reads exactly 'One prompt, start to finish', bold, top-left, one line
Every string in text_exact appears exactly once, spelled exactly as written
Lane labels are semibold near-black, same weight in all five lanes
In box 5 line 1 is 'Writes m1_stepN.txt' and line 2 is '+ change record'; the file name is never split after 'm1_'
In box 4 the word 're-reads' stays whole on one line
All five lanes have a plain white background; the only lane markings are thin light-grey horizontal rules between lanes, as in a table
Box fills: the boxes in the agy lane, the Google Cloud lane and the Answer box are soft blue with a blue border; the other three boxes are light grey with a grey border
Behind the two pills there is one filled light-grey (#F1F3F4) rounded rectangle running the full width of the frame inside the margins; both pills sit inside it with padding on every side
The five lane labels are BOLD near-black, like the row headers of a table; 'Skill files', 'Google Cloud' and 'Evidence file' each break onto two lines in the narrow label column
Text inside the six boxes and the two pills is regular weight (not bold); only the lane labels, the title and the words 'Model sign-in:' are bold
prohibitions: NO label or heading for the bottom strip: no 'Identity', 'Sign-ins' or any other word outside the two pills
NO colour-role names rendered as text: the words 'working_system', 'neutral' or any other role name never appear in the image; lane labels are only the single label listed
NO green anywhere
NO red anywhere
NO arrow labels
NO second connector between the same two boxes: each box has exactly one outgoing line and one incoming line
NO line leaving the bottom edge of any of the first five boxes; nothing enters a box from its left edge
NO 'm1_' at the end of one line with 'stepN.txt' on the next
NO seventh box, no branch, no loop-back arrow
NO word 'Antigravity'; the tool is lowercase 'agy'
NO command text, shell syntax, flags or flag values of any kind (no 'gcloud', 'curl', 'bq', 'agy -p', '--', '$', '|', 'stream-json')
NO URLs, hostnames or file paths other than the file names listed in text_exact
NO project IDs, project numbers, regions, or email addresses (nothing containing '@', 'projects/' or 'iam.gserviceaccount.com')
NO logos of any kind, including Google, Google Cloud, Gemini or Antigravity logos
NO people, faces, hands, silhouettes, robots, mascots or characters
NO 'Vertex AI', 'Agent Engine', 'reasoning engine' or 'reasoningEngines'
NO text that is not listed in text_exact: no extra labels, numbers, step numbers, captions, legend, footnote or source note
NO identifier (file name or login name) broken across two lines
NO word broken at a hyphen
NO coloured or tinted lane backgrounds; lanes are white
NO quotation marks or apostrophes around the title or any label
NO bold on the word 'Cloud' in the right pill; the whole right pill is regular weight, with 'antigravity-sa' in monospace
NO grey or faint text for any label; every label is near-black #1F2328

alt_text: One prompt, start to finish: a swimlane with five lanes: You, agy, Skill files, Google Cloud, Evidence file. Your plain-English question goes to agy, which sees the skill name and description, reads skill files when needed, runs commands on Google Cloud and re-reads any change, and writes m1_stepN.txt with a change record; an arrow then rises to the answer, built only from this file. A strip below reads: Model sign-in: Google account or API key; Cloud commands run as antigravity-sa.
